integrity: For a fixed landmark set, each a_i representation is determined exactly by the two membership bits for a_i and b_i. All indices therefore require distinct binary patterns, forcing n<=4. At n=4 all four patterns occur and the unique 00 matched pair collides across the bipartition. At n=3 exactly two pattern collections work, giving twelve resolving sets. A standalone checker recomputes every distance multiset for every vertex subset through n=8.
scientific_limitations: The scalar value for Cr_3 is published through the cycle C_6 theorem.
The new claim is the all-crown finite/infinite threshold and the full classification of the twelve resolving sets at the boundary.
The theorem concerns ordinary multiset dimension only.
Finite exhaustive verification through n=8 is corroborative only.
The full text of the 2026 census paper was unavailable during comparison; its abstract does not state a crown theorem.
title: Multiset dimension of crown graphs has a sharp finiteness threshold
